criterion: Feedback: action does what the control says
description: The Status select in Create/Edit User is ignored. Creating with 'Pending' saved ACTIVE. Editing to 'Suspended' and saving closed the dialog without error, and the row still reads ACTIVE. Staff cannot be suspended from the UI. Mapped defect 2, confirmed.
expected: The chosen status persists, or the control is removed.
actual: The row reads 'Sowmya Reddy · NURSE · ACTIVE' after both the Pending create and the Suspended edit.
suggested_fix: Add a validated status to the DTOs or call PATCH /users/:id/status from the UI; drop the forced ACTIVE on create.

description: A duplicate email gives no feedback. POST /users returned 409 'User with this email already exists'; the dialog stayed open with no toast or inline error. It surfaced only as an unhandled rejection (Next dev '1 Issue' badge). Mapped defect 15, confirmed.
expected: An inline error on the Email field: 'An account with this email already exists'.
actual: A silent failure; the button re-enables.
suggested_fix: Add catch blocks to submit() and onDelete() that set a dialog error or show a toast.

description: After Edit (Riya) then Cancel, clicking 'New User' opens a dialog titled 'Edit User' with Riya's name, email and phone and a 'Save' button. Saving would overwrite Riya's account instead of creating a new user. Mapped defect 14, confirmed.
expected: New User always opens a blank 'Create User' form.
actual: Title 'Edit User', fields prefilled with Riya Sharma's data.
suggested_fix: Reset the form in the New User trigger's onClick and in the dialog's onOpenChange(false).

description: The Role select offers only Admin, Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist, Manager and Pharmacist, while the table already lists OWNER, ACCOUNTANT and LAB_TECH users. Those roles cannot be assigned from the UI. The table shows raw enums (RECEPTION, LAB_TECH) while the dialog shows friendly labels (Receptionist).
expected: Every assignable role in the select; the same label in the table and the dialog.
actual: Mixed enum and label wording; missing roles.
suggested_fix: Use a shared ROLE_LABELS map for the table and the select.

description: Three stacked headings with near-identical descriptions sit above one table: 'Users Management / Manage clinic staff and user accounts', 'Users / Manage users, roles, and statuses', 'All Users / Manage system users and roles'.
expected: One page title and one description.
actual: Three title levels saying the same thing, pushing the table to y=408.
suggested_fix: Drop the inner 'Users' heading and the CardTitle text.

description: Each user row stacks four action buttons on three lines (Edit/Delete, Reset password, Role & Permissions), plus Working Hours/WhatsApp for doctors. Measured row height is 137px, the first row starts at y=408, and about 3 users fit in an 800px viewport. There is no search or filter.
expected: Compact rows with an overflow (…) menu for secondary actions, plus search.
actual: Heavy rows; finding a user means scrolling.
suggested_fix: Move secondary actions into a DropdownMenu; add a search input.

description: At 390px the Users table scrolls horizontally inside its card. Role, Status and Actions are off-screen with no visible scroll affordance.
actual: Only Name and a truncated Email are visible.

description: Required-phone and password-length validation use the browser's alert() modal ('Phone number is required').
